description: Trade history and net USDC flow for an Arc token, last 24 h: buys, sells, distinct buyers and sellers per 1 h / 6 h / 24 h, the latest 30 trades, and each known Uniswap v4 pool's exact swap count with USDC in and out. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
